name: ui_click
description:
Click a UI element. REQUIRED for all click operations - you must call this tool to click anything. Auto-activates window.
Clicks a UI element. Automatically activates the target window before clicking. You MUST use this tool for every click operation - each click requires a separate tool call.
Returns: The result of the click operation including success status and element information.

windowHandle.description: Window handle as decimal string (from window_management 'find' or 'list'). REQUIRED.

name.description: Element name (exact match, case-insensitive). For Electron apps, the ARIA label.

nameContains.description: Substring in element name (case-insensitive). Preferred for dialog buttons like 'Don\\'t save'.

namePattern.description: Regex pattern for element name matching.

controlType.description: Control type (Button, MenuItem, Hyperlink, ListItem, etc.)

includeDiagnostics.description: Include diagnostics (timing, query, elements scanned) in response. Default: false.
